Soon after the start of the [[Galactic War]], the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] undertook a '''mission''' to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to investigate rumors of an ancient army imprisoned by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. There, they found a [[Rakata monument]] and fought Rakata guardian droids.
